verdict.rationale: Stable's own marketing documents a self-serve forwarding action ('Ship: Forward anywhere in the world, discounted rates included'; 'forward packages'), so the core capability exists. The 'auto-route' feature sends mail to internal teams, not physical forwarding, so it doesn't count as forwarding rules. Missing for 10: rule-based or one-click forwarding, saved recipients, carrier choice, cost shown before confirmation, any API or detailed docs for forwarding, independent corroboration.
